ns2:course.label: Education and Globalization
ns2:course.description: Analyses of the role and functions of education in social, political, and economic development, with particular reference to the new and the developing countries. Same as EPOL 520. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
